page.overview:
What is Stone Dead Forever?

Stone Dead Forever is the fifteenth track from Metallica's cover album Garage, Inc.. Disc 2.

Originally released by Motörhead in 1979 on the album Bomber, Metallica had already released their version on their 1996's Hero of the Day single.

You think you see me, in the glass You think you hear me, you better listen fast I think I see you, gone to seed The only reasons, were your guilt and greed

You're out there on your own Your face turned to stone Whatever happened to your life? Stone Dead Forever
